rows.words: THE AUTHOR'S AMENDMENT to (R364), banked as an amendment row before the act's opening write, in two parts. (1) Added to (R364)(3) as (xxi), THE RESTART FLAG AFTER STEP ZERO: tools/standing/hold.py reads the flag wherever it reads the volumes and the memory, before each suite part, before each record route and before the lock; a flag set after step zero is an event, printed at once with the time of the key's last write, and the seat goes on to the next commit boundary and stops there for the author's word. Control: the reader run with a planted flag after step zero, the event printed and the stop taken at the boundary. (2) For b753's corrigendum: the flag was set at 2026-11-11T18:12:42Z, inside b753, and b753's close ran with it pending and unread, (R363)(7)(vii) reading the flag at step zero alone; entered as an event of b753, CLOSE, NEW, the navigator's, the reach of that rule having been the navigator's to set.

rows.words:
Option 2: repair the reader. I do not paste the ruling again. THE AUTHOR'S AMENDMENT to (R364), row 2, banked before the act's opening write, in four parts.

(1) THE FERRY READER, added to (R364)(3) as (xxii) and landed now, at step zero, before the citation check. tools/b677_citation.py's ferry_text takes a user text as a delivery where one of its lines is the ruling's opening marker and nothing else, and a later line is the ferry's closing marker and nothing else; a text that quotes the two markers inside a sentence is no delivery. Among the texts that qualify, over the act's sessions in chain order, it takes the last and prints how many qualified; where none qualifies it refuses. The (W) list gains tools/b677_citation.py. Controls, printed before the citation check runs: your three-way table again, the ruling's session alone and the two sessions in chain order each reading 72,187 characters equal to the bank, and this session alone refusing; and b753's ferry read from its own session equal to data/b753_ferry.txt.

(2) The cause is the navigator's and is lettered so in this act's defects: the word I pasted at 15:57Z quoted both marker lines in one sentence, as did the file-read line the navigator gave me this morning. Its class is the one of b753 (s'), a matcher taking a name inside quoted words for the thing named.

(3) Your two readings stand as you made them. The old carry ran at step zero as (8) orders, and (3)(ii)'s control is a replay under the repaired carry in Component 1. The hook's positive control runs now, act_current naming b754 as a working file, before the opening commit; that it could not run while act_current named the closed act is entered for (3)(xix): that control follows the working act_current and precedes its commit.

(4) If the model of this session has changed since your step-zero print, print it as the transcript's rows now give it, enter the change as an event under (3)(xvii), and restate under (3)(xviii) before any write.

Then go on with step zero from where you stopped.
